description: Design tokens for the Pathway design system: semantic colour with Light and Midnight modes, layout and unit tokens, and composite type styles as CSS classes. Generated from the Figma Variables panel, so these are the same values the design source carries and the same values the npm package ships.
PLC communication C# source bindings and Windows x64 native runtime. Copies the C# bindings into the consuming project on build and deploys the native DLL to build and publish output.

Atlassian Document Format (ADF) for .NET: a typed document model, fluent builder, validation, and ADF conversion to and from HTML, Markdown and JSON. Meta-package that installs AdfDotNet.Core and every converter package.
HTML to Atlassian Document Format (ADF) conversion and back for AdfDotNet, built on HtmlAgilityPack. Usable statically or through dependency injection.
Markdown to Atlassian Document Format (ADF) conversion and back for AdfDotNet, built on Markdig (CommonMark + GFM). Usable statically or through dependency injection.
Typed .NET document model for the Atlassian Document Format (ADF) used by Jira and Confluence: every node and mark type in the ADF spec, a fluent builder, spec-based validation and normalization.
Lossless Atlassian Document Format (ADF) JSON serialization for AdfDotNet, built on Newtonsoft.Json. Usable statically or through dependency injection.
Zautha for ASP.NET Core: authenticate API requests by their Zautha session token (JwtBearer with the instance's JWKS and an azp check) and manage users and sessions through the Backend API.
Pure C# high-throughput embedded Vector Database and SIMD similarity metric engine (HNSW graph & Flat contiguous indices) with zero-allocation memory discipline for .NET.
Pure C# enterprise-grade cognitive AI Agent runtime (ReAct loop, tool registry, episodic memory via ZeroVector, and multi-agent swarm) for .NET.
Pure C# high-speed Byte-Pair Encoding (BPE), Tiktoken, and LLM context token budgeter engine with zero-allocation memory discipline for .NET.
Interactive PostgreSQL log tailer with auto-detection, filtering, semantic highlighting, and a full screen tail mode.
